identitySignals: Name matches exactly the State of California agency 'California Department of Social Services' (cdss.ca.gov), the only state agency of that name; OUSD's records name it as the grantor/funding source

CDSS has a Refugee Programs Bureau that works with schools to help refugees resettle, consistent with the Refugee School Impact / newcomer education grant OUSD's English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement office receives
research.notes: WebSearch budget was exhausted, so the CalNEW / Refugee School Impact grant link to CDSS was not confirmed on a fetched page (the CDSS pages fetched describe the Refugee Programs Bureau but do not name CalNEW). The CDE CalNEW page redirected to a bot-check and was not used. Identity rests on the unambiguous agency name plus OUSD's own grant records.

profile.summary: The California Department of Social Services is a state government agency that supports programs serving more than eight million people in California. These include cash aid, food benefits, in-home support services, child welfare and adult protective services. Its Refugee Programs Bureau works with counties, resettlement agencies, schools and community organizations to help refugees resettle in California.

sources.title: Contact Us - California Department of Social Services
Refugee Programs Bureau - California Department of Social Services

review.notes: OUSD's records name the California Department of Social Services as the grantor of the CalNEW/Refugee School Impact grant; the cited cdss.ca.gov pages confirm the agency name, the eight-million-people scope, the Refugee Programs Bureau's work with counties, resettlement agencies, schools and community organizations, and the general contact details (phone, Public Inquiry and Response Unit email, 744 P Street address). The CalNEW grant itself is not named on the fetched CDSS pages, but the agency name is unambiguous and the summary makes no grant claim.
